dct_title_s: Continuation of Kvænangen (Inset Map). Scandinavia, Norway--northwest coast (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: This layer is a georeferenced image of an inset map titled "Continuation of Kvænangen." The original map appears in "Scandinavia, Norway--northwest coast, Kågen to Nøklan" (Map no. *43102"). This layer is part of a selection of digitally scanned and georeferenced maps from The Branner Library Map Collection at Stanford University.

Historic paper maps can provide an excellent view of the changes that have occurred in the cultural and physical landscape. The wide range of information provided on these maps make them useful in the study of historic geography, and urban and rural land use change. As this map has been georeferenced, it can be used in a GIS as a source or background layer in conjunction with other GIS data.
